mapper.sql: f.id, f.semester_id, f.teacher_id, u.name AS teacherName, u.user_no AS teacherNo, p.college_id AS collegeId, c.name AS collegeName, f.status, f.submitted_at, f.review_at, f.review_note, f.correct_deadline, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_form_item i WHERE i.form_id = f.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS itemCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) FROM order_form_item i WHERE i.form_id = f.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS totalQuantity
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_semester_profile p2 WHERE p2.user_id = f.teacher_id AND p2.semester_id = f.semester_id AND p2.college_id = #{collegeId} AND p2.deleted = 0)
mapper.select: SELECT p.college_id AS collegeId, c.name AS collegeName, f.status AS status, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM order_form f JOIN user_semester_profile p ON p.user_id = f.teacher_id AND p.semester_id = f.semester_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN college c ON c.id = p.college_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.semester_id = #{semesterId} GROUP BY p.college_id, c.name, f.status
